subject: general
question: In which of the following places was the regional workshop on 'Sangathan, Swasthya, Samriddhi: Women Collective’s Action on Food, Nutrition, Health and Water, Sanitation and Hygiene,' held from 22ⁿd to 23rd July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranchi, Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The regional workshop titled **'Sangathan, Swasthya, Samriddhi: Women Collective’s Action on Food, Nutrition, Health and Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (FNHW)'** was organized in **Ranchi, Jharkhand**.
 
• The event was held over two days, from **22nd to 23rd July 2025**, specifically targeting the **Eastern region** of India to enhance community-led health initiatives.
 
• The workshop was spearheaded by the **Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)**, which operates under the **Ministry of Rural Development**, Government of India.
 
• The primary focus of the workshop was to integrate **Food, Nutrition, Health, and WASH** interventions into the core activities of **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)** and their federations to ensure holistic rural development.
 
• It saw active participation from the **State Rural Livelihoods Missions (SRLMs)** of states including **Jharkhand, Bihar, Odisha, West Bengal, and Chhattisgarh**, facilitating a cross-learning platform for successful community models.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Ranchi, Jharkhand**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM):**
 
 
• Launched in **June 2011**, this flagship program aims to reduce poverty by organizing **rural poor households** into **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)** and fostering sustainable **livelihood** opportunities.
 
• The mission has a massive footprint, covering over **7,000 blocks** across India and mobilizing approximately **10 crore women** into the SHG fold.
 
 
 
• **Lakhpati Didi Initiative:**
 
 
• A major strategic goal discussed during such workshops is the **Lakhpati Didi** scheme, which aims to empower **3 crore women** SHG members to earn an annual income of at least **Rs. 1 lakh**.
 
• This is achieved through **diversification of livelihoods**, technical training, and providing **market linkages** for rural products.
 
 
 
• **FNHW Integration:**
 
 
• The **Food, Nutrition, Health, and WASH (FNHW)** vertical within DAY-NRLM leverages the social capital of women’s collectives to drive **Social and Behavior Change Communication (SBCC)**.
 
• Key activities include the promotion of **Nutri-gardens (Poshan Vatikas)**, breast-feeding practices, and **menstrual hygiene management** among rural communities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Strategic Convergence:** The mission works in convergence with the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** and the **Ministry of Jal Shakti** to achieve **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, particularly **SDG 2 (Zero Hunger)** and **SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being)**.
 
• **Community Resource Persons (CRPs):** The workshop emphasized training **CRPs** who act as change agents at the village level, helping to monitor **nutritional outcomes** and the usage of **toilets and safe drinking water** under the **Jal Jeevan Mission**.
 
• **Regional Focus:** Conducting the workshop in **Ranchi** highlights the government's commitment to the **Eastern region**, where high rates of **malnutrition** and **anaemia** are being addressed through localized women-led strategies.
